novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a cross-lingual mechanism hypothesis: a “single shared magnitude manifold across notations and languages” whose “geometric fidelity tracks quantitative-reasoning skill,” rather than merely the already-known existence of decodable numerical magnitude. Searches using “LLM number line hidden states cross-lingual,” “shared number magnitude subspace digits number words,” and “causal numerical representation activation steering” identified Wallace et al., “Do NLP Models Know Numbers? Probing Numeracy in Embeddings” (2019), and the much closer “Language Models Use Trigonometry to Do Addition” (2025), which already proposes structured numerical geometry and causal interventions in arithmetic representations. Extending that geometry to test one aligned code across several languages and notations, then relating its fidelity to competence, is a substantive multi-step integration but a natural extension of existing numerical-geometry and multilingual-alignment work rather than a new core interpretability paradigm.
